name: Gmail

tiers.how: Sage reads Gmail via the Google API over OAuth (scopes gmail.readonly + calendar.events) using `assistant/agent/google_api.py`. The owner must complete the OAuth consent flow once; the refresh token is stored in the OS credential store. This path is strictly read-only and does not draft or send.

Sage also reads and appends drafts via IMAP using `assistant/scripts/mail.py`, with the app password stored in the OS credential store via `assistant/scripts/setup_creds.py`. The one and only send path is `assistant/scripts/email_send.py` (SMTP from an allow-listed identity). All send operations require an approval card before `email_send.py` is called; no other send path exists.
writes: drafts (appended via IMAP; never sent without approval)
always_tap: any reply to a client or lead

gotchas: The ONLY send path is `assistant/scripts/email_send.py`; never route a send through any other mechanism.
Sends are restricted to an allow-listed set of identities configured in `email_send.py`; any from-address not on the list is refused.
The Google API path (`google_api.py`) is read-only and cannot draft or send.
App passwords require 2-step verification to be enabled on the Google account.
notes: Gmail is the primary long-form correspondence channel; drafts may be created freely but sending always requires owner approval via `email_send.py`.
